y-m-49-02.topic: Furuci da musun kishiyarsa (tushen yanke hukunci kan gaskiya ko ƙarya).
y-m-49-02.goal: Gano da musun kishiya cewa “duba misalai kaɗan” ba hujjar cewa furuci gaskiya ne ba, sannan ƙirƙiri cikakkiyar lamba x da za ta nuna furucin ƙarya ne.
y-m-49-02.material:
Furuci R game da lambar ainihi x: “Idan x²>4, to x>2.” (Idan murabba’in x ya fi 4, to x ya fi 2.)
Mina ta yi amfani da musun kishiya don bincika ko R gaskiya ce, kamar haka. Furuci na asali da musun kishiyarsa kullum suna da ƙimar gaskiya iri ɗaya.

y-m-49-02.s.s1.line.2: Saka x=2, x=1, x=0 yana ba da x² na 4, 1, 0, dukkansu 4 ko ƙasa, saboda haka musun kishiyar gaskiya ne.
y-m-49-02.s.s1.line.3: Musun kishiyar gaskiya ne, saboda haka R ma gaskiya ce.
y-m-49-02.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ne. Gaskiyar ƙimomi uku x=2, 1, 0 ba hujjar cewa tana aiki ga “duk lambobin ainihi x≤2” ba. y-m-49-03.goal: Gane cewa bayanan adadin membobi da aka bayar kaɗai ba su kayyade amsa ba, warware ƙarin bayanin da zai kayyade ta, sannan ka gina kewayon ƙimomi masu yiwuwa da kanka.
y-m-49-03.material:
An binciki duk ɗalibai 30 na aji guda ko sun shiga ƙungiyar lissafi ko ta kimiyya. 17 sun shiga ƙungiyar lissafi A, 14 kuma ƙungiyar kimiyya B. Ɗalibi na iya shiga ƙungiyoyin biyun, kuma akwai waɗanda ba su shiga ko ɗaya ba. Ba a san adadin waɗanda suka shiga biyun ko waɗanda ba su shiga ba tukuna.
Abin da ake son nemo: adadin ɗaliban da ba su shiga ko ɗaya ba.

y-m-49-06.title: Hujjojin ɗalibai huɗu: wane rubutu ne ya tabbatar da S?
y-m-49-06.topic: Hujjar furuci (hujja ta hanyar akasin sharadi, hujja ta hanyar saɓani, da bambance su da akasin furuci)
y-m-49-06.goal: Tsara hujjojin huɗu da za a amince da su, sannan ka bayyana abin da rubutu da ya musanya sharadi da ƙarshe yake tabbatarwa.
y-m-49-06.material:
Furuci S game da cikakkun lambobi masu kyau a da b: 'Idan ab ba shi da saura idan aka raba da 2, wato odd ne, to a da b duka odd ne.'
Ɗalibai huɗu kowannensu ya rubuta cewa ya tabbatar da S.
가: Idan a=3, b=5, to ab=15 odd ne, kuma a da b duka odd ne. Idan a=7, b=9, to ab=63 odd ne, su biyun kuma odd ne. Saboda haka S gaskiya ce.
나: A ɗauka aƙalla ɗaya daga a da b even ne. Idan muka kira wannan even da 2k (k cikakkiyar lamba ce mai kyau), to ab yana da 2k a matsayin mai ninkawa, saboda haka even ne. Don haka idan ab odd ne, a da b duka odd ne.
다: A ɗauka a da b duka odd ne. Idan a=2m+1 kuma b=2n+1 (m da n cikakkun lambobi ne 0 ko fiye), to ab=4mn+2m+2n+1=2(2mn+m+n)+1, saboda haka odd ne. Don haka an tabbatar da S.
라: A ɗauka ab odd ne kuma a even ne. Idan a=2k ne, to ab=2kb even ne. Wannan ya saɓa wa zaton cewa ab odd ne, don haka a odd ne. Haka nan b ma odd ne.

y-m-49-06.thinking.2: Bambanta akasin furuci da furucin asali

y-m-49-06.s.s1.r.a: Tabbatar da furuci game da 'dukkan cikakkun lambobi masu kyau a, b' da wasu misalai kaɗan ba zai yiwu ba. Duba ko akwai hujja ta gabaɗaya maimakon misalai.

y-m-49-01.title: Sharudda biyu iri ɗaya: shin alaƙar tana sauyawa idan tushe ya canza?
y-m-49-01.topic: Sharuddan zama wajibi da isasshe (hukunci ya danganta da babban saiti)
y-m-49-01.goal: Yanke hukuncin dangantakar zama dole da isasshe ta sharudda biyu ta duba alkiblar “idan ... to ...” biyun, sannan ka bayyana yadda sabon bayani (cikakken sifar mafita, canjin saitin duniya) ke sauya hukunci.
y-m-49-01.material:
Akwai sharudda biyu game da lambar ainihi x.
p: x²−3x+2=0 (x murabba’i a cire 3x a ƙara 2 daidai yake da 0)
q: x=1
Idan “idan p to q” gaskiya ne, p sharadi ne isasshe ga q; idan “idan q to p” gaskiya ne, p sharadi ne dole ga q. Idan biyun gaskiya ne, sharadi ne dole kuma isasshe. Da farko saitin duniya dukkan lambobin ainihi ne.
y-m-49-01.thinking.0: Jinkirta hukunci idan hujja ta yi ƙaranci.
y-m-49-01.thinking.1: Gane cewa alkibla guda ba gaskiya ba ce ta amfani da misalin ƙaryatawa.
y-m-49-01.thinking.2: Gane cewa gaskiyar sharadi ta danganta da saitin duniya.

y-m-49-04.material:
Saitin duniya U={1, 2, 3, 4}, kuma A={1, 2}. Wata da’awa T game da ƙananan saitunan B da C na U:
“Idan A∩B=A∩C, to B=C.”
Lokacin gina B da C a ƙasa, rubuta 1 a akwatunan b1 zuwa b4 idan kowane kashi 1, 2, 3, 4 yana cikin B, in ba haka ba 0; yi haka ga C a akwatunan c1 zuwa c4. (Misali, idan B={1, 3}, to b1=1, b2=0, b3=1, b4=0.)

y-m-49-10.prereq.0: “H3” a wannan aiki matakin wahala da tallafi ne kawai a samarwa, ba sanya wa wani aji a manhaja ba. A ɗauka mai koyo ya riga ya san kalmomin asali na sashen “Sets and Propositions” na Common Math na sakandare (saiti, ƙaramin saiti, furuci, sharadi, sharuddan isasshe da dole).
y-m-49-10.title: Yaya nisa ya kamata mu ƙyale ƙimar iyaka k?
y-m-49-10.topic: Sharuɗɗa masu buƙata kuma isassun (yawan kewayon na yau da kullun da ke gamsar da yanayi)
y-m-49-10.goal: alkali, la'akari da kimar iyaka, kewayon k wanda x>k ya isa ga x²>9, kuma yayi hukunci tare da dalilai ko akwai k wanda ya zama dole.
y-m-49-10.material:
Akwai sharuɗɗa game da lamba ta gaske x: p: x>k (k tabbataccen dindindin ne) da q: x²> 9 (x squared ya fi 9 girma). Dalibai uku sun yi iƙirari daban-daban game da 'kewayon k wanda ya sa p ya zama isashen sharadi ga q'.
Domin: k>3
Harin: k≥3 (k shine 3 ko fiye)
Seojun: k≥−3 (k shine -3 ko fiye)
y-m-49-10.thinking.0: Yi hukunci da ƙimar iyaka (alamar daidai)
y-m-49-10.thinking.1: Kwatanta da kimanta da'awar dalibai uku
y-m-49-10.thinking.2: Yi bayani ta amfani da yanayin inda babu mafita
y-m-49-10.prereq.1: Magani na rashin daidaituwar ma'auni x²>9 (x<-3 ko x>3)
y-m-49-10.prereq.2: Cewa 'idan p to q' kasancewa gaskiya yana nufin saitin gaskiya na p yana cikin saƙon gaskiya na q
y-m-49-10.s.s1.prompt: Wanne daidai kewayon k wanda ya sa p ya zama isasshiyar sharadi don q?
y-m-49-10.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta kewayon x wanda ya gamsar da p don k=3 da k=2.9, kuma gwada ko q ya gamsu.
y-m-49-10.s.s1.hint.1: Lokacin da k ke tsakanin -3 da 3, nemo x wanda ya gamsar da p amma bai gamsar da q ba.
y-m-49-10.s.s1.r.a: Duba ko 'idan x>3, to x²>9' yana riƙe da ƙimar iyaka k=3. Idan ya riƙe, babu dalilin barin k=3.
y-m-49-10.s.s1.r.b: Wannan hukunci ne wanda ya duba ƙimar iyaka k=3 kai tsaye kuma ya gwada ko wani x ya karya ta lokacin da k bai wuce 3 ba.
y-m-49-10.s.s1.r.c: Zaɓi k ɗaya tare da -3 <k<3 (misali, k=0) kuma duba ko akwai x mai x>k da x²≤9.
y-m-49-10.s.s1.r.d: Duba jagorar alamar rashin daidaituwa. Lokacin da k=0, x=1 ya gamsar da p, amma yaya game da q?
y-m-49-10.s.s1.explain: Idan k=3, sannan x>3, idan kuma x>3, to x²>9 ya rike. Idan k>3, kewayon p yana ƙara kunkuntar, don haka yana riƙe kuma. Idan k<3, akwai darajar x waɗanda suka fi k girma kuma tsakanin -3 da 3, suna ba da x²≤9, don haka ya karye. Don haka k≥3.
y-m-49-10.s.s2.prompt: A wannan karon, yi tunani ko akwai k da ke sanya p zama 'labarai' na q. ('Idan q to p' dole ne koyaushe ya zama gaskiya.) Wanne ne daidai hukuncin?
y-m-49-10.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi k daga -3, 0, 3, 100 ɗaya a lokaci ɗaya kuma sami x wanda zai gamsar da q amma bai gamsar da p.
y-m-49-10.s.s2.hint.1: Ko da yake ƙanƙanta da kuka ɗauka k, yi tunani ko ko ƙaramin x ya fi wannan ya gamsar da q.
y-m-49-10.s.s2.r.a: Lokacin k=-3, x=-4 ya gamsar da q amma baya gamsar da p (x>-3). Shin kun duba mummunan gefen mafita na q?
y-m-49-10.s.s2.r.b: Wannan kewayon shine kewayon 'isasshen yanayi' daga matakin farko. x=-4 ya gamsar da q amma bai gamsar da p. Faɗa kwatance dabam.
y-m-49-10.s.s2.o.c: Ya isa k ya zama isasshe ƙarami
y-m-49-10.s.s2.r.c: Bincika ko, duk da ƙananan k shine, mummunan x ƙarami fiye da yadda har yanzu yana gamsar da q amma bai gamsar da p.
y-m-49-10.s.s2.r.d: Wannan hukunci ne da ke nuni da cewa mafita na q yana ba da iyaka ba tare da iyakancewa zuwa ga mummunan gefe ba, don haka duk abin da kuka zaɓa, akwai x wanda ya karya shi.
y-m-49-10.s.s2.explain: Maganganun q sun haɗa da dabi'u x<-3 zuwa ga ƙaramin gefe. Duk abin da kuka ɗauka, x shine 1 ƙasa da ƙarami na k kuma -4 yana da x²> 9 amma ba x>k ba. Don haka babu k wanda 'idan q to p' ya kasance gaskiya koyaushe.
y-m-49-10.s.s3.prompt: Rubuta dalilin hukuncin da kuka zaba a cikin s2. Sanya shi dalilin da ke aiki don kowane ƙimar k ya ɗauka, ba kawai don takamaiman k.
y-m-49-10.s.s3.hint.0: Nemo x wanda zai gamsar da q kuma baya gamsar da p lokacin da k -1000 da lokacin k shine 100.
y-m-49-10.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta a cikin jumla ɗaya yadda kuka zaɓi x ya dogara da k.
y-m-49-10.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin rubutunku yana magana ne akan 'kowane k' ba kawai k ɗaya ba?
y-m-49-10.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin kun bincika kai tsaye cewa x ɗin da kuka bayar ya gamsar da q kuma bai gamsar da p?
y-m-49-10.s.s3.model.0: Ko menene darajar k, idan ka ɗauki x ya zama lamba ƙasa da k kuma ƙasa da -3 (misali, ƙarami na k da -4, debe 1), to x²>9 amma x>k baya riƙe. Don haka maganar 'idan q to p' kullum karya ce.
